name: Heptral 400mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET

HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET contains S-Adenosyl-L-Methionine which belongs to the group of medicines called Amino acid derivatives. It is used to manage liver problems such as intrahepatic cholestasis (ICP; block in bile flow), liver cirrhosis, hepatitis and alcoholic liver disease in adults.

It can also be used to manage ICP of pregnancy and can reduce the fatigue caused by chronic liver problems. It also helps to reduce joint pain (osteoarthritis), fibromyalgia (severe muscle pain with memory and mood problems), anxiety, depression and other mental illnesses.

Before taking HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have bipolar disorder or a previous history of suicidal thoughts as a precaution.

Vitamins such as folic acid and vitamin B12 are essential to enhance the effects of S-Adenosyl-L-Methionine in your body. Therefore, inform your doctor if you have any vitamin deficiencies or anemia as a precaution. You doctor may advise you to take B-vitamin supplements (folic acid and vitamin B12) along with this medicine.

During management with HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET your doctor will routinely monitor the levels of ammonia, folic acid and vitamin B12 in your blood as a precaution and adjust the dose accordingly.

Do not take HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET are nausea, stomach pain and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

Intrahepatic cholestasis during pregnancy
Liver diseases (liver cirrhosis, hepatitis and alcoholic liver disease)
Fatigue caused due to chronic liver problems
Anxiety, depression and other mental illnesses
Osteoarthritis (joint pain)
Fibromyalgia (severe muscle pain causing memory and mood changes)

mechanismOfAction:
How HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET Works

HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET protects your liver against various toxins (free radicals) and helps your liver to function normally. It improves the levels of glutathione (an antioxidant) in the liver which helps in managing further liver cell damage.

It also increases the levels of certain chemical messengers (such as dopamine, noradrenaline, adrenaline, serotonin, melatonin) in the brain that can stabilize mood and mental health. It can also reduce the production of certain chemicals in the body that causes pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET

Take HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not cursh or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness after taking HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET as a precaution.
HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET if you are allergic to S-Adenosyl-L-Methionine.

Others

HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have bipolar disease (alternative episodes of happiness and sadness)

Before taking HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have anemia (low RBC in blood)
Have vitamin B12 or folic acid deficiency
Have a previous history of suicidal thoughts

Use in pediatrics:

The safety and effectiveness of HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET have not been established in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

HEPTRAL 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

name: URSOLID 300mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About URSOLID 300MG TABLET

URSOLID 300MG TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, URSOLID 300MG TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

URSOLID 300MG TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

URSOLID 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. URSOLID 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

URSOLID 300MG TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. URSOLID 300MG TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with URSOLID 300MG TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking URSOLID 300MG TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)
Gallstones (not visible on X-rays in patients with a functioning gall bladder)
Liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to 18 years
usesDetails:
Uses Of URSOLID 300MG TABLET

Used to manage:

Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)

mechanismOfAction:
How URSOLID 300MG TABLET Works

URSOLID 300MG TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.
usageInstructions: Always use URSOLID 300MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Take this medicine with or after meals.
For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water or milk. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of URSOLID 300MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.
Continue to take URSOLID 300MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
If you feel that the effect of URSOLID 300MG TABLET is too strong or too weak for you, please talk to your doctor.

name: Viboliv 500mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About VIBOLIV 500MG TABLET

VIBOLIV 500MG TABLET contains Metadoxine, which belongs to a group of medicines called Alcohol Deterrents. VIBOLIV 500MG TABLET is used in the management of alcohol intoxication, which occurs as a disturbance in behaviour/mental function during or after alcohol consumption in affected individuals.

VIBOLIV 500MG TABLET is also used to manage chronic alcoholism, which occurs due to habitual and prolonged use of alcoholic beverages in affected individuals.

VIBOLIV 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by patients allergic to Metadoxine.

Before taking VIBOLIV 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you suffer from Parkinson's disease (a brain disorder that causes unintended or uncontrollable movements) and/or have kidney problems or liver problems (such as alcoholic liver damage).

VIBOLIV 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is clearly necessary. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it reduces the synthesis of prolactin (the hormone responsible for producing milk during pregnancy and after birth).

The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking VIBOLIV 500MG TABLET are diarrhea, skin rash, numbness, and/or drowsiness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

To manage chronic alcoholism

mechanismOfAction:
How VIBOLIV 500MG TABLET Works

VIBOLIV 500MG TABLET works by increasing alcohol elimination from blood and tissues, which results in reduced absorption of alcohol by the liver, thus aiding in alcohol intoxication and reducing liver damage in affected individuals.

How to use VIBOLIV 500MG TABLET

Take VIBOLIV 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Hepamerz Granules 5gm
introduction:
Introduction About HEPAMERZ GRANULES

HEPAMERZ GRANULES contains L-ornithine-L-aspartate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Hepatoprotective agents. It is used in the management of concomitant diseases and complications caused by deterioration of liver detoxification function, with symptoms of latent or severe hepatic encephalopathy and consciousness disorders such as precoma or coma.

L-ornithine-l-aspartate is made up of two amino acids called ornithine and aspartic acid. Both l-ornithine and l-aspartic acid ensure hepatoprotective effects by decreasing the toxic load on the liver and by providing metabolic support for hepatic cells. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have severe liver disease, because your doctor might adjust the dose on an individual basis to avoid nausea and vomiting.

This medicine is well tolerated with minimal side effects. However, if you experience any unusual symptoms after taking this medicine, inform your doctor. Do not take this medicine if you have severe renal impairment, diabetes, or fructose intolerance. Ask your doctor for advice. If a high dose of this medicine is used, it is important to monitor the levels of urea both in the serum and urine to avoid toxicity. Ask your doctor for advice before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
uses: Restores normal liver function
Manages concomitant diseases caused by deterioration of liver function
Manages symptoms of latent or severe hepatic encephalopathy
Manages consciousness disorders such as precoma or coma
usesDetails:
Uses Of HEPAMERZ GRANULES
Restores normal liver function

Manages consciousness disorders such as precoma or coma
mechanismOfAction:
How HEPAMERZ GRANULES Works

L-ornithine converts toxic ammonia into non-toxic urea, which is eliminated via the kidneys. By doing this, it lowers the elevated level of toxic load (ammonia) in blood and helps the diseased liver to carry out its normal function smoothly (detoxification). L-aspartate is an important component of the citric acid cycle, which liberates energy in the form of ATP, which helps in the regeneration of damaged liver cells.
usageDetails:
How to use HEPAMERZ GRANULES

Always take this medicine as directed by your physician. Dissolve the contents of 1-2 sachets in a large amount of fluid (Ex. in a glass of water or juice) and consume orally, 3 times a day during or after meals. introduction:
Introduction About NUSAM NEW 200 TABLET

NUSAM NEW 200 TABLET contains S-Adenosyl-L-Methionine which belongs to the group of medicines called Amino acid derivatives. It is used to manage liver problems such as intrahepatic cholestasis (ICP; block in bile flow), liver cirrhosis, hepatitis and alcoholic liver disease in adults.

It can also be used to manage ICP of pregnancy and can reduce the fatigue caused by chronic liver problems. It also helps to reduce joint pain (osteoarthritis), fibromyalgia (severe muscle pain with memory and mood problems), anxiety, depression and other mental illnesses.

Before taking NUSAM NEW 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have bipolar disorder or a previous history of suicidal thoughts as a precaution.

Vitamins such as folic acid and vitamin B12 are essential to enhance the effects of S-Adenosyl-L-Methionine in your body. Therefore, inform your doctor if you have any vitamin deficiencies or anemia as a precaution. You doctor may advise you to take B-vitamin supplements (folic acid and vitamin B12) along with this medicine.

During management with NUSAM NEW 200 TABLET your doctor will routinely monitor the levels of ammonia, folic acid and vitamin B12 in your blood as a precaution and adjust the dose accordingly.

Do not take NUSAM NEW 200 TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking NUSAM NEW 200 TABLET are nausea, stomach pain and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How NUSAM NEW 200 TABLET Works

NUSAM NEW 200 TABLET protects your liver against various toxins (free radicals) and helps your liver to function normally. It improves the levels of glutathione (an antioxidant) in the liver which helps in managing further liver cell damage.

It also increases the levels of certain chemical messengers (such as dopamine, noradrenaline, adrenaline, serotonin, melatonin) in the brain that can stabilize mood and mental health. It can also reduce the production of certain chemicals in the body that causes pain and inflammation.

Take NUSAM NEW 200 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not cursh or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Udiliv 300mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About UDILIV 300MG TABLET

UDILIV 300MG TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, UDILIV 300MG TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

UDILIV 300MG TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

UDILIV 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. UDILIV 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

UDILIV 300MG TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. UDILIV 300MG TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with UDILIV 300MG TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking UDILIV 300MG TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)
Gallstones (not visible on X-rays in patients with a functioning gall bladder)
Liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to 18 years
usesDetails:

Used to manage:

Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)
Gallstones (not visible on X-rays in patients with a functioning gall bladder)

mechanismOfAction:
How UDILIV 300MG TABLET Works

UDILIV 300MG TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.
usageInstructions: Always use UDILIV 300MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Take this medicine with or after meals.
For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water or milk. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of UDILIV 300MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.
Continue to take UDILIV 300MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
If you feel that the effect of UDILIV 300MG TABLET is too strong or too weak for you, please talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About REHEPTIN TABLET

Reheptin Tablet is a dietary supplement is used in the management of Acute and chronic hepatitis, Chronic alcoholic liver damage, Fatty Liver (steatosis), Non-alcoholic steatohepatitis, Jaundice, Chronic viral hepatitis, and Liver cirrhosis. It contains Metadoxine, Silymarin, L Ornithine L Aspartate, Folic acid, and Pyridoxine as active ingredients which have a hepatoprotective nature.

Metadoxine is an antioxidant that exerts a protective effect against the toxic effects of alcohol. Silymarin manages the damage caused by free radicals and acts as a rejuvenating agent, which helps in regenerating the damaged liver cells.

L-Ornithine L-Aspartate converts ammonia to urea, leading to a reduced burden on the liver and thus increasing the functional capacity of the liver. Folic acid and pyridoxine fulfil the micronutrient deficiency associated with liver diseases.

Always take a Reheptin Tablet as advised by your physician. Do not exceed the recommended daily intake. Take one tablet a day or as advised by your doctor. Contact your doctor if you notice any allergic reactions while taking it.

name: Udiliv 150mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About UDILIV 150MG TABLET

UDILIV 150MG TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, UDILIV 150MG TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

UDILIV 150MG TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

UDILIV 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. UDILIV 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

UDILIV 150MG TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. UDILIV 150MG TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with UDILIV 150MG TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking UDILIV 150MG TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)
Gallstones (not visible on X-rays in patients with a functioning gall bladder)
Liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to 18 years
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How UDILIV 150MG TABLET Works

UDILIV 150MG TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.
usageInstructions: Always use UDILIV 150MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Take this medicine with or after meals.
For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water or milk. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of UDILIV 150MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.
Continue to take UDILIV 150MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
If you feel that the effect of UDILIV 150MG TABLET is too strong or too weak for you, please talk to your doctor.

Have improper functioning of gall bladder

Have an acute inflammation of the biliary tract or gall bladder

Experience frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen

name: Hepamerz Tablet 10'S
introduction:
INTRODUCTION

HEPAMERZ TABLET is a combination of L Ornithine L Aspartate and Pancreatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Hepatoprotectors. It is used to treat acute and chronic hepatitis (inflammation of liver), cirrhosis of liver (scarring of liver tissue), jaundice (yellowish discolouration of skin and whites of eye), fatty liver or alcoholic liver disease, Liver protection against drugs and alcohol, atonic constipation, and hepatic encephalopathy (brain disorder due to severe liver disease). It is also used in adjunct to hepatotoxic drugs.

L Ornithine L Aspartate is an Amino acids works by increasing the levels of ornithine and aspartic acid in the body, these amino acids help to reduce levels of toxic chemical called ammonia in the blood. This helps to regenerate damaged liver cells which helps liver to carry out its functions smoothly and Pancreatin is a Digestive enzyme. Thus treating the liver disease and improves digestion.

Before taking HEPAMERZ TABLET inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing diseases. There is limited information available on the use of HEPAMERZ TABLET in pregnancy and breast-feeding women. Contact you are doctor before taking. The most common side effects of taking HEPAMERZ TABLET are nausea, stomach pain, diarrhea, bloating, constipation. Contact your physician if the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About SILYBON SUSPENSION

SILYBON SUSPENSION contains Silymarin which belongs to the group of medicines called Flavonoids. Silymarin is a flavonoid isolated from the plant species called Silybum marianum which is commonly known as milk thistle. It is indicated for supportive management in chronic liver disease and cirrhosis.

Before taking SILYBON SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have allergic to milk thistle or plants of the Asteraceae/Compositae family such as daisies, marigolds, or artichokes.

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies of SILYBON SUSPENSION in pregnancy and lactation. Consult your doctor for advice.

SILYBON SUSPENSION is not recommended in children less than 5 years of age. Consult your doctor for advice.

SILYBON SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients, consult your doctor for advice.

Generally, SILYBON SUSPENSION is well tolerated, however a few side effects like gastro-intestinal discomfort including anorexia, nausea or diarrhoea and headache may be seen. If any of these side effects worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: Used for supportive management in chronic liver disease and cirrhosis
usesDetails:
Uses Of SILYBON SUSPENSION
Used for supportive management in chronic liver disease and cirrhosis
mechanismOfAction:
How SILYBON SUSPENSION Works

SILYBON SUSPENSION contains Silymarin, is an herbal remedy that has been used for centuries for liver diseases. The hepatoprotective and antioxidant activities of silymarin effectively lowers the oxidative liver damage by inhibiting the formation of free radicals. Silymarin also enhances the cellular regeneration of hepatocytes (liver cells) by stimulating the activity of an enzyme called RNA polymerase. It also improves the overall functional capacity of the liver and aids in metabolism and digestion.

name: ESTUCHOL 300 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET

ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)
Gallstones (not visible on X-rays in patients with a functioning gall bladder)
Liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to 18 years
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET Works

ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.

Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.
Continue to take ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
If you feel that the effect of ESTUCHOL 300 TABLET is too strong or too weak for you, please talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About SAMLOL SACHET

SAMLOL SACHET contains L-ornithine-L-aspartate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Hepatoprotective agents. It is used in the management of concomitant diseases and complications caused by deterioration of liver detoxification function, with symptoms of latent or severe hepatic encephalopathy and consciousness disorders such as precoma or coma.

L-ornithine-l-aspartate is made up of two amino acids called ornithine and aspartic acid. Both l-ornithine and l-aspartic acid ensure hepatoprotective effects by decreasing the toxic load on the liver and by providing metabolic support for hepatic cells. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have severe liver disease, because your doctor might adjust the dose on an individual basis to avoid nausea and vomiting.

This medicine is well tolerated with minimal side effects. However, if you experience any unusual symptoms after taking this medicine, inform your doctor. Do not take this medicine if you have severe renal impairment, diabetes, or fructose intolerance. Ask your doctor for advice. If a high dose of this medicine is used, it is important to monitor the levels of urea both in the serum and urine to avoid toxicity. Ask your doctor for advice before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
uses: Restores normal liver function
Manages concomitant diseases caused by deterioration of liver function
Manages symptoms of latent or severe hepatic encephalopathy
Manages consciousness disorders such as precoma or coma
usesDetails:
Uses Of SAMLOL SACHET
Restores normal liver function
Manages concomitant diseases caused by deterioration of liver function
Manages symptoms of latent or severe hepatic encephalopathy
Manages consciousness disorders such as precoma or coma
mechanismOfAction:
How SAMLOL SACHET Works

L-ornithine converts toxic ammonia into non-toxic urea, which is eliminated via the kidneys. By doing this, it lowers the elevated level of toxic load (ammonia) in blood and helps the diseased liver to carry out its normal function smoothly (detoxification). L-aspartate is an important component of the citric acid cycle, which liberates energy in the form of ATP, which helps in the regeneration of damaged liver cells.
usageDetails:
How to use SAMLOL SACHET

Always take this medicine as directed by your physician. Dissolve the contents of 1-2 sachets in a large amount of fluid (Ex. in a glass of water or juice) and consume orally, 3 times a day during or after meals. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Continue to take this medicine as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of SAMLOL SACHET

SAMLOL SACHET is generally safe and does not cause any side effects. However, if you experience any unusual symptoms after taking this medicine, inform your doctor.

warnings.details: SAMLOL SACHET should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
SAMLOL SACHET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate any machines if your ability is affected by this medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, because alcohol can reduce the chances of healing and worsen liver damage.
Do not take SAMLOL SACHET if you suffer from renal insufficiency (severely impaired kidney function). Consult your doctor for advice.
SAMLOL SACHET should be taken with caution in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Dose adjustments have to be made on an individual basis to avoid nausea and vomiting.
Do not take this medicine if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to l-ornithine-l-aspartate.

introduction:
Introduction About SILYBON 70MG TABLET

SILYBON 70MG TABLET contains Silymarin which belongs to the group of medicines called Flavonoids. Silymarin is a flavonoid isolated from the plant species called Silybum marianum which is commonly known as milk thistle.

SILYBON 70MG TABLET is indicated as adjunctive therapy in the management of liver disease of varying conditions like acute hepatitis, chronic persistent and chronic aggressive hepatitis, cirrhosis of liver, fatty liver, toxic metabolic or toxic metabolic liver damage. It has been shown to protect the liver from damage caused by general anaesthesia because of its excellent hepatoprotective action.

Before taking SILYBON 70MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have allergic to milk thistle or plants of the Asteraceae/Compositae family such as daisies, marigolds, or artichokes.

SILYBON 70MG TABLET is generally not recommended during pregnancy and breast-feeding. Consult your doctor for advice.

SILYBON 70MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients and is contraindicated in children and adolescents below 18 years of age.

Generally, SILYBON 70MG TABLET is well tolerated, however a few side effects like gastro-intestinal discomfort including anorexia, nausea or diarrhoea and headache may be seen. If any of these side effects worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

Used for supportive management in chronic liver disease, cirrhosis and indigestion
mechanismOfAction:
How SILYBON 70MG TABLET Works

SILYBON 70MG TABLET contains Silymarin, is an herbal remedy that has been used for centuries for liver diseases. The hepatoprotective and antioxidant activities of silymarin effectively lowers the oxidative liver damage by inhibiting the formation of free radicals. Silymarin also enhances the cellular regeneration of hepatocytes (liver cells) by stimulating the activity of an enzyme called RNA polymerase. It also improves the overall functional capacity of the liver and aids in metabolism and digestion.

introduction:
Introduction About MICROLIV FORTE TABLET

MICROLIV FORTE TABLET is a combination of Metadoxine, Silymarin and L Ornithine L Aspartate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antioxidants, Flavonolignans and Amino acid salts respectively. It is used as supportive management in chronic liver disease and cirrhosis.  

Chronic liver disease (CLD) is a continuous process of inflammation, destruction and regeneration of functional liver cells, which leads to cirrhosis (disruption of liver structure and function). Symptoms include fluid build-up in the belly, itching, yellow skin and eyes, muscle loss, loss of appetite, easy bruising, low energy and weakness, weight loss and confusion.

Consult your doctor before giving MICROLIV FORTE TABLET to your child. Before taking MICROLIV FORTE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing conditions or allergies. MICROLIV FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary by your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking MICROLIV FORTE TABLET are gastrointestinal disturbances (such as indigestion, diarrhoea), nausea and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: HEPLOFIT Sachet 5gm
introduction:
Introduction About HEPLOFIT SACHET

HEPLOFIT SACHET contains L-ornithine-L-aspartate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Hepatoprotective agents. It is used in the management of concomitant diseases and complications caused by deterioration of liver detoxification function, with symptoms of latent or severe hepatic encephalopathy and consciousness disorders such as precoma or coma.

L-ornithine-l-aspartate is made up of two amino acids called ornithine and aspartic acid. Both l-ornithine and l-aspartic acid ensure hepatoprotective effects by decreasing the toxic load on the liver and by providing metabolic support for hepatic cells. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have severe liver disease, because your doctor might adjust the dose on an individual basis to avoid nausea and vomiting.

This medicine is well tolerated with minimal side effects. However, if you experience any unusual symptoms after taking this medicine, inform your doctor. Do not take this medicine if you have severe renal impairment, diabetes, or fructose intolerance. Ask your doctor for advice. If a high dose of this medicine is used, it is important to monitor the levels of urea both in the serum and urine to avoid toxicity. Ask your doctor for advice before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
uses: Restores normal liver function
Manages concomitant diseases caused by deterioration of liver function
Manages symptoms of latent or severe hepatic encephalopathy
Manages consciousness disorders such as precoma or coma
usesDetails:
Uses Of HEPLOFIT SACHET
Restores normal liver function
Manages concomitant diseases caused by deterioration of liver function
Manages symptoms of latent or severe hepatic encephalopathy
Manages consciousness disorders such as precoma or coma
mechanismOfAction:
How HEPLOFIT SACHET Works

L-ornithine converts toxic ammonia into non-toxic urea, which is eliminated via the kidneys. By doing this, it lowers the elevated level of toxic load (ammonia) in blood and helps the diseased liver to carry out its normal function smoothly (detoxification). L-aspartate is an important component of the citric acid cycle, which liberates energy in the form of ATP, which helps in the regeneration of damaged liver cells.
usageDetails:
How to use HEPLOFIT SACHET

Always take this medicine as directed by your physician. Dissolve the contents of 1-2 sachets in a large amount of fluid (Ex. in a glass of water or juice) and consume orally, 3 times a day during or after meals. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Continue to take this medicine as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of HEPLOFIT SACHET

HEPLOFIT SACHET is generally safe and does not cause any side effects. However, if you experience any unusual symptoms after taking this medicine, inform your doctor.

warnings.details: HEPLOFIT SACHET should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
HEPLOFIT SACHET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate any machines if your ability is affected by this medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, because alcohol can reduce the chances of healing and worsen liver damage.
Do not take HEPLOFIT SACHET if you suffer from renal insufficiency (severely impaired kidney function). Consult your doctor for advice.

HEPLOFIT SACHET should be taken with caution in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Dose adjustments have to be made on an individual basis to avoid nausea and vomiting.
Do not take this medicine if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to l-ornithine-l-aspartate.

introduction:
Introduction About LIVERIL U 150MG TABLET

LIVERIL U 150MG TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, LIVERIL U 150MG TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

LIVERIL U 150MG TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

LIVERIL U 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. LIVERIL U 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

LIVERIL U 150MG TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. LIVERIL U 150MG TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with LIVERIL U 150MG TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking LIVERIL U 150MG TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.

UDILINK TABLET contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement. It is used to manage primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile).

UDILINK TABLET is also used to dissolve small gallstones that are not visible on X-rays (less than 15 mm in diameter) in patients with a functioning gall bladder. Gall stones are hardened deposits mostly made up of cholesterol that can form in the gallbladder and can cause sharp, intense pain in the upper right part of the abdomen.

UDILINK TABLET can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years. UDILINK TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. UDILINK TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

UDILINK TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. UDILINK TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with UDILINK TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking UDILINK TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.

name: Sorbiline Syrup 200ml
introduction:
Introduction About SORBILINE SYRUP

Sorbiline Syrup is a combination of Sorbitol and Tricholine which belongs to the group of medicines called Laxatives and Bile acid binding agents respectively. It is used in the management of constipation and helps in improving appetite. It is also used as an adjuvant in the management of fatty liver disease (accumulation of fat in the liver) and hepatotoxicity.

Before starting the management with Sorbiline Syrup, your doctor might ask you take several diagnostic tests. Before taking Sorbiline Syrup inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung, or heart diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Sorbiline Syrup is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It should not be given to children unless prescribed by a doctor. The most common side effects of taking Sorbiline Syrup are nausea, gas, diarrhoea, stomach cramps, and anal irritation. Consult your doctor’s advice if any of these side effects or persists for a longer duration.

mechanismOfAction:
How SORBILINE SYRUP Works

Sorbiline Syrup is a combination of Sorbitol and Tricholine. Sorbitol is a Laxative which acts by drawing water from the tissues into the large intestine thus improving the bowel movements and relieving constipation. Tricholine is a bile acid binding agent which breaks down fat and converts the deposited fat into good cholesterol, hence helps in the management of fatty liver and makes liver function better.

name: Fortibile 300mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About FORTIBILE 300MG TABLET

FORTIBILE 300MG TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, FORTIBILE 300MG TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

FORTIBILE 300MG TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

FORTIBILE 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. FORTIBILE 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

FORTIBILE 300MG TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. FORTIBILE 300MG TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with FORTIBILE 300MG TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking FORTIBILE 300MG TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)
Gallstones (not visible on X-rays in patients with a functioning gall bladder)
Liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to 18 years
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How FORTIBILE 300MG TABLET Works

FORTIBILE 300MG TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.

Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of FORTIBILE 300MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.
Continue to take FORTIBILE 300MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

name: Liverubin 70mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About LIVERUBIN 70MG TABLET

LIVERUBIN 70MG TABLET contains Silymarin which belongs to the group of medicines called Flavonoids. Silymarin is a flavonoid isolated from the plant species called Silybum marianum which is commonly known as milk thistle.

LIVERUBIN 70MG TABLET is indicated as adjunctive therapy in the management of liver disease of varying conditions like acute hepatitis, chronic persistent and chronic aggressive hepatitis, cirrhosis of liver, fatty liver, toxic metabolic or toxic metabolic liver damage. It has been shown to protect the liver from damage caused by general anaesthesia because of its excellent hepatoprotective action.

Before taking LIVERUBIN 70MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have allergic to milk thistle or plants of the Asteraceae/Compositae family such as daisies, marigolds, or artichokes.

LIVERUBIN 70MG TABLET is generally not recommended during pregnancy and breast-feeding. Consult your doctor for advice.

LIVERUBIN 70MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients and is contraindicated in children and adolescents below 18 years of age.

Generally, LIVERUBIN 70MG TABLET is well tolerated, however a few side effects like gastro-intestinal discomfort including anorexia, nausea or diarrhoea and headache may be seen. If any of these side effects worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How LIVERUBIN 70MG TABLET Works

LIVERUBIN 70MG TABLET contains Silymarin, is an herbal remedy that has been used for centuries for liver diseases. The hepatoprotective and antioxidant activities of silymarin effectively lowers the oxidative liver damage by inhibiting the formation of free radicals. Silymarin also enhances the cellular regeneration of hepatocytes (liver cells) by stimulating the activity of an enzyme called RNA polymerase. It also improves the overall functional capacity of the liver and aids in metabolism and digestion.

introduction:
Introduction About SORBIDIOL 150MG TABLET

SORBIDIOL 150MG TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, SORBIDIOL 150MG TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

SORBIDIOL 150MG TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

SORBIDIOL 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. SORBIDIOL 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

SORBIDIOL 150MG TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. SORBIDIOL 150MG TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with SORBIDIOL 150MG TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking SORBIDIOL 150MG TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.

How SORBIDIOL 150MG TABLET Works

SORBIDIOL 150MG TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.

name: Ensame 200mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ENSAME 200MG TABLET

ENSAME 200MG TABLET contains S-Adenosyl-L-Methionine which belongs to the group of medicines called Amino acid derivatives. It is used to manage liver problems such as intrahepatic cholestasis (ICP; block in bile flow), liver cirrhosis, hepatitis and alcoholic liver disease in adults.

It can also be used to manage ICP of pregnancy and can reduce the fatigue caused by chronic liver problems. It also helps to reduce joint pain (osteoarthritis), fibromyalgia (severe muscle pain with memory and mood problems), anxiety, depression and other mental illnesses.

Before taking ENSAME 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have bipolar disorder or a previous history of suicidal thoughts as a precaution.

Vitamins such as folic acid and vitamin B12 are essential to enhance the effects of S-Adenosyl-L-Methionine in your body. Therefore, inform your doctor if you have any vitamin deficiencies or anemia as a precaution. You doctor may advise you to take B-vitamin supplements (folic acid and vitamin B12) along with this medicine.

During management with ENSAME 200MG TABLET your doctor will routinely monitor the levels of ammonia, folic acid and vitamin B12 in your blood as a precaution and adjust the dose accordingly.

Do not take ENSAME 200MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ENSAME 200MG TABLET are nausea, stomach pain and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

ENSAME 200MG TABLET protects your liver against various toxins (free radicals) and helps your liver to function normally. It improves the levels of glutathione (an antioxidant) in the liver which helps in managing further liver cell damage.

It also increases the levels of certain chemical messengers (such as dopamine, noradrenaline, adrenaline, serotonin, melatonin) in the brain that can stabilize mood and mental health. It can also reduce the production of certain chemicals in the body that causes pain and inflammation.

name: HEPALAIR 5gm
introduction:
Introduction About HEPALAIR

HEPALAIR contains L-ornithine-L-aspartate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Hepatoprotective agents. It is used in the management of concomitant diseases and complications caused by deterioration of liver detoxification function, with symptoms of latent or severe hepatic encephalopathy and consciousness disorders such as precoma or coma.

L-ornithine-l-aspartate is made up of two amino acids called ornithine and aspartic acid. Both l-ornithine and l-aspartic acid ensure hepatoprotective effects by decreasing the toxic load on the liver and by providing metabolic support for hepatic cells. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have severe liver disease, because your doctor might adjust the dose on an individual basis to avoid nausea and vomiting.

This medicine is well tolerated with minimal side effects. However, if you experience any unusual symptoms after taking this medicine, inform your doctor. Do not take this medicine if you have severe renal impairment, diabetes, or fructose intolerance. Ask your doctor for advice. If a high dose of this medicine is used, it is important to monitor the levels of urea both in the serum and urine to avoid toxicity. Ask your doctor for advice before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

Manages concomitant diseases caused by deterioration of liver function
Manages symptoms of latent or severe hepatic encephalopathy
Manages consciousness disorders such as precoma or coma
usesDetails:

Manages symptoms of latent or severe hepatic encephalopathy

mechanismOfAction:
How HEPALAIR Works

L-ornithine converts toxic ammonia into non-toxic urea, which is eliminated via the kidneys. By doing this, it lowers the elevated level of toxic load (ammonia) in blood and helps the diseased liver to carry out its normal function smoothly (detoxification). L-aspartate is an important component of the citric acid cycle, which liberates energy in the form of ATP, which helps in the regeneration of damaged liver cells.
usageDetails:
How to use HEPALAIR

Always take this medicine as directed by your physician. Dissolve the contents of 1-2 sachets in a large amount of fluid (Ex. in a glass of water or juice) and consume orally, 3 times a day during or after meals. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Continue to take this medicine as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of HEPALAIR

HEPALAIR is generally safe and does not cause any side effects. However, if you experience any unusual symptoms after taking this medicine, inform your doctor.

warnings.details: HEPALAIR should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
HEPALAIR should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate any machines if your ability is affected by this medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine, because alcohol can reduce the chances of healing and worsen liver damage.
Do not take HEPALAIR if you suffer from renal insufficiency (severely impaired kidney function). Consult your doctor for advice.
HEPALAIR should be taken with caution in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor for advice. Dose adjustments have to be made on an individual basis to avoid nausea and vomiting.
Do not take this medicine if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to l-ornithine-l-aspartate.

name: Livrite Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About LIVRITE TABLET

LIVRITE TABLET is a combination of Acetylcysteine, Alpha Lipoic Acid, Selenomethionine and Silymarin which belongs to the group of medicines called Amino acids, Antioxidant, Amino acids, Flavonolignans respectively. It is used to manage jaundice (yellowish discolouration of skin or whites of the eye), alcoholic liver disorder, and viral hepatitis (infection of the liver causing inflammation or liver damage due to hepatitis A, B, C, D, E viruses).

It also manages alcoholic hepatitis (inflammation of the liver due to excessive alcohol consumption), non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (build-up of fat in the liver due to obesity) and to minimize the hepatotoxic effects of anti-TB chemotherapy.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. LIVRITE TABLET is not recommended in patients with biliary obstruction. LIVRITE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver and kidney disease or on dialysis, high blood pressure, congestive heart failure, stomach ulcer, bleeding problems, undergoing any surgeries, diabetes, thyroid problems, anaemia, cancer, vitamin-B1 (thiamine deficiency).

LIVRITE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary. The most common side effects of taking LIVRITE TABLET are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, fever, or skin rashes. Consult your physician if you experience any side effects.

How LIVRITE TABLET Works

LIVRITE TABLET helps to manage liver damage, where Acetylcysteine, alpha lipoic acids and silymarin acts as an antioxidant and helps to neutralise the free radicals (responsible for liver damage) and selenomethionine acts by stabilizing liver cell membranes, thereby reducing their entry to certain toxic substances. Together they manage liver disease effectively.

introduction:
Introduction About URSOCOL SR 450MG TABLET

URSOCOL SR 450MG TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, URSOCOL SR 450MG TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

URSOCOL SR 450MG TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

URSOCOL SR 450MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. URSOCOL SR 450MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

URSOCOL SR 450MG TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. URSOCOL SR 450MG TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with URSOCOL SR 450MG TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking URSOCOL SR 450MG TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.

URSOCOL SR 450MG TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.

name: Udihep Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About UDIHEP TABLET

Udihep Tablet is a Hepatoprotective medicine used to manage the formation of gall bladder stones and to dissolve them. It can also be used to manage primary biliary cirrhosis, Hepatobiliary disorders associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6-18 years, and Total parenteral nutrition (TPN) -induced cholestasis in children.

Udihep Tablet contains Ursodeoxycholic acid as an active ingredient that helps to decrease the amount of cholesterol in the blood and to improve overall liver functioning.

Ursodeoxycholic acid acts by lowering the amount of cholesterol in the blood. Moreover, it also improves liver enzymes and protects liver cells from injury caused due to toxic bile acid, that in turn helps to improve overall liver function.

Always take Udihep Tablet exactly as advised by your doctor. Swallow Udihep Tablet with a glass of water. Do not exceed the stated daily recommended dosages. Before taking Udihep Tablet inform your doctor if you have inflammation in gallbladder or a history of liver, and kidney diseases.

introduction:

UDITEC 150 TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, UDITEC 150 TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

UDITEC 150 TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

UDITEC 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. UDITEC 150 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

UDITEC 150 TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with UDITEC 150 TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking UDITEC 150 TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How UDITEC 150 TABLET Works

UDITEC 150 TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.

Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of UDITEC 150 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.
Continue to take UDITEC 150 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
If you feel that the effect of UDITEC 150 TABLET is too strong or too weak for you, please talk to your doctor.

Introduction About SORLIV SOLUTION

Sorliv Sugar Free Solution is a dietary supplement used to improve liver functioning, appetite, manage hepatotoxicity, normalise intestinal moments and provides relief from constipation. It contains Sorbitol and Tricholine Citrate as the active ingredients, which removes bile acids from the body and has laxative effects.

Tricholine citrate is a bile acid binding agent and removes bile acids from the body. The liver then makes more bile acids using cholesterol resulting in reduced cholesterol levels. Sorbitol acts as a base agent and as an osmotic laxative to relieve constipation.

Take Sorliv Sugar Free Solution as advised by your doctor. Shake the bottle well before using it. It can be taken by infants, children, and adults. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosage. It is generally taken before meals.

Introduction About UDISAK 300 TABLET

UDISAK 300 TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, UDISAK 300 TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

UDISAK 300 TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

UDISAK 300 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. UDISAK 300 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

UDISAK 300 TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. UDISAK 300 TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with UDISAK 300 TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking UDISAK 300 TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.

introduction:
Introduction About LIVERIL FORTE TABLET

Liveril Forte Tablet is a nutritional supplement containing a sensibly balanced blend of vitamins and trace minerals. It contains silymarin extract with N-acetyl L-cysteine, choline, L-carnitine and L-glutathione as active ingredients. It helps to detoxify the liver and maintain liver health. It can also help with liver damage caused due to alcohol, fatty liver and acute or chronic liver conditions.

Silymarin has hepato-protective properties that increase liver function. It has antioxidant action, that reduces inflammatory reactions and inhibits fibrogenesis in the liver. It also helps to rejuvenate the liver and repair damaged liver cells. Choline helps to maintain normal liver function. Vitamin C, zinc and selenium protect the cells from oxidative stress. Vitamin D helps in the normal function of the immune system. Thiamine (Vitamin B1) and folate help in the normal energy-yielding metabolism.

Always take Liveril Forte Tablet as advised by your doctor. Recommended usage is one tablet daily after the main meal. Do not exceed the recommended daily usage. Do not take Liveril Forte Tablet if you are allergic to any of its constituents. In case of difficulty in swallowing, break the tablet. Inform your doctor if you are using or have recently used any other medicines including prescription, over the counter medications, as well as vitamin or herbal supplements.

introduction:
Introduction About URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET

URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)
Gallstones (not visible on X-rays in patients with a functioning gall bladder)
Liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to 18 years
usesDetails:

Used to manage:

Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)

mechanismOfAction:
How URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET Works

URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.
usageInstructions: Always use URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Take this medicine with or after meals.
For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water or milk. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.
Continue to take URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
If you feel that the effect of URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET is too strong or too weak for you, please talk to your doctor.

warnings.details: URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary by the doctor.
URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it passes through breast milk.
URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET has no or negligible effect on driving or using machine.
URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Your doctor might advise you for frequent liver examination and tests during the management.
Do not take URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET if you are allergic to allergic to Ursodeoxycholic Acid or bile acids or any other components of this medicine.

URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET should be used in children only if prescribed by the physician. It should not be used in children with biliary atresia (blockage in bile duct) or in children having poor bile flow, even after surgery.
URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET can be used in elderly patients under medical supervision.

Others

URSOCOL SR 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have improper functioning of gall bladder
Have calcified gallstones which are visible on an x-ray
Have an acute inflammation of the biliary tract or gall bladder
Have a blockage of the cystic duct or common bile duct (obstruction of the biliary tract)
Experience frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen

introduction:
Introduction About LIVOPILL TABLET

LIVOPILL TABLET is a combination of Metadoxine, Silymarin and L Ornithine L Aspartate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antioxidants, Flavonolignans and Amino acid salts respectively. It is used as supportive management in chronic liver disease and cirrhosis.  

Chronic liver disease (CLD) is a continuous process of inflammation, destruction and regeneration of functional liver cells, which leads to cirrhosis (disruption of liver structure and function). Symptoms include fluid build-up in the belly, itching, yellow skin and eyes, muscle loss, loss of appetite, easy bruising, low energy and weakness, weight loss and confusion.

Consult your doctor before giving LIVOPILL TABLET to your child. Before taking LIVOPILL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing conditions or allergies. LIVOPILL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary by your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking LIVOPILL TABLET are gastrointestinal disturbances (such as indigestion, diarrhoea), nausea and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: As supportive management in chronic liver disease and cirrhosis
usesDetails:
Uses Of LIVOPILL TABLET
As supportive management in chronic liver disease and cirrhosis
mechanismOfAction:
How LIVOPILL TABLET Works

LIVOPILL TABLET improves liver function where metadoxine exerts a protective effect against the damage done by free radicals, silymarin acts as a rejuvenating agent which helps in regenerating the damaged liver cells and in liver decongestion and L-Ornithine L-Aspartate converts ammonia to urea, leading to reduced burden of the liver and thus increases functional capacity of the liver.
usageDetails:
How to use LIVOPILL TABLET

Take LIVOPILL TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the appropriate dose and duration for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Gastrointestinal disturbances (such as diarrhea, irregular stools and indigestion)
sideEffectsDetails:

Anaphylactic reactions
Rash, hives

Consult your doctor if you feel any side effect during management with LIVOPILL TABLET that may stop you from driving or using machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with LIVOPILL TABLET.
Do not take LIVOPILL TABLET if you are allergic to Metadoxine, Silymarin, L Ornithine L Aspartate or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Before taking LIVOPILL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Any pre-existing allergic disease

Use in pediatrics:

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies of LIVOPILL TABLET in infants. Consult your child’s doctor before giving it to them.

name: UDA 300MG TABLET 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About UDA 300MG TABLET

UDA 300MG TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, UDA 300MG TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

UDA 300MG TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

UDA 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. UDA 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

UDA 300MG TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. UDA 300MG TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with UDA 300MG TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking UDA 300MG TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)
Gallstones (not visible on X-rays in patients with a functioning gall bladder)
Liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to 18 years

mechanismOfAction:
How UDA 300MG TABLET Works

UDA 300MG TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.
usageInstructions: Always use UDA 300MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Take this medicine with or after meals.
For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water or milk. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of UDA 300MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.
Continue to take UDA 300MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
If you feel that the effect of UDA 300MG TABLET is too strong or too weak for you, please talk to your doctor.

warnings.details: UDA 300MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary by the doctor.
UDA 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it passes through breast milk.
UDA 300MG TABLET has no or negligible effect on driving or using machine.
UDA 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Your doctor might advise you for frequent liver examination and tests during the management.
Do not take UDA 300MG TABLET if you are allergic to allergic to Ursodeoxycholic Acid or bile acids or any other components of this medicine.

UDA 300MG TABLET should be used in children only if prescribed by the physician. It should not be used in children with biliary atresia (blockage in bile duct) or in children having poor bile flow, even after surgery.
UDA 300MG TABLET can be used in elderly patients under medical supervision.

Others

UDA 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have improper functioning of gall bladder
Have calcified gallstones which are visible on an x-ray
Have an acute inflammation of the biliary tract or gall bladder
Have a blockage of the cystic duct or common bile duct (obstruction of the biliary tract)
Experience frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen
