name: Silmaliv 70mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SILMALIV 70MG TABLET

SILMALIV 70MG TABLET contains Silymarin which belongs to the group of medicines called Flavonoids. Silymarin is a flavonoid isolated from the plant species called Silybum marianum which is commonly known as milk thistle.

SILMALIV 70MG TABLET is indicated as adjunctive therapy in the management of liver disease of varying conditions like acute hepatitis, chronic persistent and chronic aggressive hepatitis, cirrhosis of liver, fatty liver, toxic metabolic or toxic metabolic liver damage. It has been shown to protect the liver from damage caused by general anaesthesia because of its excellent hepatoprotective action.

Before taking SILMALIV 70MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have allergic to milk thistle or plants of the Asteraceae/Compositae family such as daisies, marigolds, or artichokes.

SILMALIV 70MG TABLET is generally not recommended during pregnancy and breast-feeding. Consult your doctor for advice.

SILMALIV 70MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients and is contraindicated in children and adolescents below 18 years of age.

Generally, SILMALIV 70MG TABLET is well tolerated, however a few side effects like gastro-intestinal discomfort including anorexia, nausea or diarrhoea and headache may be seen. If any of these side effects worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: Used for supportive management in chronic liver disease, cirrhosis and indigestion
usesDetails:
Uses Of SILMALIV 70MG TABLET
Used for supportive management in chronic liver disease, cirrhosis and indigestion
mechanismOfAction:
How SILMALIV 70MG TABLET Works

SILMALIV 70MG TABLET contains Silymarin, is an herbal remedy that has been used for centuries for liver diseases. The hepatoprotective and antioxidant activities of silymarin effectively lowers the oxidative liver damage by inhibiting the formation of free radicals. Silymarin also enhances the cellular regeneration of hepatocytes (liver cells) by stimulating the activity of an enzyme called RNA polymerase. It also improves the overall functional capacity of the liver and aids in metabolism and digestion.

name: Ursetor 300mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About URSETOR 300MG TABLET

URSETOR 300MG TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, URSETOR 300MG TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

URSETOR 300MG TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

URSETOR 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. URSETOR 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

URSETOR 300MG TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. URSETOR 300MG TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with URSETOR 300MG TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking URSETOR 300MG TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)
Gallstones (not visible on X-rays in patients with a functioning gall bladder)
Liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to 18 years
usesDetails:
Uses Of URSETOR 300MG TABLET

Used to manage:

Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)
Gallstones (not visible on X-rays in patients with a functioning gall bladder)

mechanismOfAction:
How URSETOR 300MG TABLET Works

URSETOR 300MG TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.
usageInstructions: Always use URSETOR 300MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Take this medicine with or after meals.
For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water or milk. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of URSETOR 300MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.
Continue to take URSETOR 300MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
If you feel that the effect of URSETOR 300MG TABLET is too strong or too weak for you, please talk to your doctor.

warnings.details: URSETOR 300MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary by the doctor.
URSETOR 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it passes through breast milk.
URSETOR 300MG TABLET has no or negligible effect on driving or using machine.
URSETOR 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Your doctor might advise you for frequent liver examination and tests during the management.
Do not take URSETOR 300MG TABLET if you are allergic to allergic to Ursodeoxycholic Acid or bile acids or any other components of this medicine.

URSETOR 300MG TABLET should be used in children only if prescribed by the physician. It should not be used in children with biliary atresia (blockage in bile duct) or in children having poor bile flow, even after surgery.
URSETOR 300MG TABLET can be used in elderly patients under medical supervision.

Others

URSETOR 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have improper functioning of gall bladder
Have calcified gallstones which are visible on an x-ray
Have an acute inflammation of the biliary tract or gall bladder
Have a blockage of the cystic duct or common bile duct (obstruction of the biliary tract)
Experience frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen

name: HEPAMERZ Infusion 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About HEPAMERZ INFUSION

HEPAMERZ INFUSION contains L-Ornithine L-Aspartate which belongs to the group of medicines called Amino Acids. It is used to manage latent and prominent hepatic encephalopathy (decline in brain function as a result of liver failure) and liver cirrhosis (condition in which your liver is scarred and permanently damaged).  

During management with HEPAMERZ INFUSION, your doctor might advise you to undertake blood investigations before and during management such as kidney and liver function test to manage the risk of any unusual effects.  

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving HEPAMERZ INFUSION. It is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney function impairment (renal failure). Consult your doctor before receiving it.  

HEPAMERZ INFUSION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe liver damage. HEPAMERZ INFUSION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor.

The common side effects of receiving HEPAMERZ INFUSION are nausea, vomiting, cough, muscle cramps and diarrhoea. Inform your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens or persist for a long period of time.
uses: Manage latent and prominent hepatic encephalopathy
Manage liver cirrhosis
usesDetails:
Uses Of HEPAMERZ INFUSION
Manage latent and prominent hepatic encephalopathy
Manage liver cirrhosis
mechanismOfAction:
How HEPAMERZ INFUSION Works

HEPAMERZ INFUSION helps in improving liver function by helping in urea synthesis in liver (important metabolic process in the body), reduces levels of ammonia from liver, muscles and brain, helps in normalizing the levels of liver enzymes. It also protects the liver from further damage by drugs, alcohol and promotes liver regeneration by increasing liver energy balance.
usageDetails:
How to use HEPAMERZ INFUSION

HEPAMERZ INFUSION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage and management duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRISOLIV SYRUP

TRISOLIV SYRUP is a combination of Tricholine citrate and Andrographis paniculata which belongs to the group of medicines called lipotropic and hepatoprotective respectively. It is used to manage liver dysfunctions, atonic constipation (decrease in bowel movements due to weakness of muscles of intestine), loss of appetite. It is also used in combination with Anti-Tuberculosis drug.

TRISOLIV SYRUP is not recommended for use if you have obstructive jaundice (yellowish discolouration of skin and eyes), multiple sclerosis (disease of the brain and spinal cord), systemic lupus erythematosus (the immune system attacks its own tissues) and rheumatoid arthritis (chronic inflammatory disease of hands and feet). Consult your doctor before taking it.

TRISOLIV SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with low blood pressure, bleeding problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

TRISOLIV SYRUP is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRISOLIV SYRUP is safe to use in children and in infants. If you experience any side effects after taking TRISOLIV SYRUP, consult your doctor.

name: Ursolid 150mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About URSOLID 150MG TABLET

URSOLID 150MG TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, URSOLID 150MG TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

URSOLID 150MG TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

URSOLID 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. URSOLID 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

URSOLID 150MG TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. URSOLID 150MG TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with URSOLID 150MG TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking URSOLID 150MG TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)
Gallstones (not visible on X-rays in patients with a functioning gall bladder)
Liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to 18 years
usesDetails:

Used to manage:

Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)
Gallstones (not visible on X-rays in patients with a functioning gall bladder)

mechanismOfAction:
How URSOLID 150MG TABLET Works

URSOLID 150MG TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.
usageInstructions: Always use URSOLID 150MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Take this medicine with or after meals.
For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water or milk. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of URSOLID 150MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.
Continue to take URSOLID 150MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
If you feel that the effect of URSOLID 150MG TABLET is too strong or too weak for you, please talk to your doctor.

Have an acute inflammation of the biliary tract or gall bladder

Experience frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen

introduction:
Introduction About THIOTRES 600MG INJECTION

THIOTRES 600MG INJECTION contains Glutathione which belongs to the group of medicines called Antioxidants. It is used to manage alcoholic fatty liver (disease that occurs due to heavy alcohol use), liver fibrosis/cirrhosis (scarring of liver due to excessive consumption of alcohol), and hepatitis (inflammation of liver) in affected individuals.

THIOTRES 600MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Glutathione. Before receiving THIOTRES 600MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you suffer from liver problems (such as chronic hepatitis), and kidney problems (such as acute renal failure).

THIOTRES 600MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in neonates, premature infants, children, and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving THIOTRES 600MG INJECTION are anorexia (eating disorder), nausea, vomiting, and/or rash. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About SEDOGEST 150MG TABLET

SEDOGEST 150MG TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, SEDOGEST 150MG TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

SEDOGEST 150MG TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

SEDOGEST 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. SEDOGEST 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

SEDOGEST 150MG TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. SEDOGEST 150MG TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with SEDOGEST 150MG TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking SEDOGEST 150MG TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.

The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.

name: PHOSLAM 400 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About PHOSLAM 400 TABLET

PHOSLAM 400 TABLET contains Sevelamer, which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphate Binding Agents. It is used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with long-term kidney disease who are on dialysis. Renal failure is the most common cause of high phosphorous levels, as there is reduced filtration of inorganic phosphate, increasing its serum levels.

During management, your doctor might ask you to take certain tests to avoid any untoward side effects. Follow the diet as advised by your doctor.

PHOSLAM 400 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low levels of phosphorus in the blood or bowel obstruction. PHOSLAM 400 TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have trouble swallowing, motility problems in the stomach and bowel, and in those who have undergone major bowel surgery.

PHOSLAM 400 TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. It is unknown whether PHOSLAM 400 TABLET is excreted in breast milk and may affect your baby, so consult your doctor before taking it during breastfeeding.  PHOSLAM 400 TABLET is not intended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking PHOSLAM 400 TABLET are constipation, vomiting, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, flatulence (gas), etc. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with chronic kidney disease who are on dialysis
usesDetails:

Used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with chronic kidney disease who are on dialysis
mechanismOfAction:
How PHOSLAM 400 TABLET Works

PHOSLAM 400 TABLET is a chelating agent that helps in reducing the phosphorus levels in the blood by binding to the phosphate that enters the body with food and managing its absorption.

Take PHOSLAM 400 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration of PHOSLAM 400 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking PHOSLAM 400 TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About USIBON 300MG TABLET

USIBON 300MG TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, USIBON 300MG TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

USIBON 300MG TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

USIBON 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. USIBON 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

USIBON 300MG TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. USIBON 300MG TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with USIBON 300MG TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking USIBON 300MG TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.

usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How USIBON 300MG TABLET Works

USIBON 300MG TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.
usageInstructions: Always use USIBON 300MG TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Take this medicine with or after meals.
For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water or milk. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of USIBON 300MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.
Continue to take USIBON 300MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
If you feel that the effect of USIBON 300MG TABLET is too strong or too weak for you, please talk to your doctor.

warnings.details: USIBON 300MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary by the doctor.
USIBON 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it passes through breast milk.
USIBON 300MG TABLET has no or negligible effect on driving or using machine.
USIBON 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Your doctor might advise you for frequent liver examination and tests during the management.
Do not take USIBON 300MG TABLET if you are allergic to allergic to Ursodeoxycholic Acid or bile acids or any other components of this medicine.

USIBON 300MG TABLET should be used in children only if prescribed by the physician. It should not be used in children with biliary atresia (blockage in bile duct) or in children having poor bile flow, even after surgery.
USIBON 300MG TABLET can be used in elderly patients under medical supervision.

Others

USIBON 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have improper functioning of gall bladder
Have calcified gallstones which are visible on an x-ray
Have an acute inflammation of the biliary tract or gall bladder
Have a blockage of the cystic duct or common bile duct (obstruction of the biliary tract)
Experience frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen

name: Proliser Syrup 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About PROLISER SYRUP

Proliser Syrup is a urine alkalizer used in urinary disorders. It has Potassium Citrate Monohydrate and Citric Acid Monohydrate as active ingredients. It regulates urine pH in patients with excess uric acid or urine crystalline calculi (kidney stone) in urinary tract. It is used as an adjuvant therapy in gout. It corrects acidosis of certain renal tubular disorders.

Potassium citrate and citric acid are alkalizing agents. It works by make the urine less acidic reduces uric acid content in the urine thus manage occurrence of kidney stones. It removes excess acid or bicarbonates present in the renal tubules.

Take Proliser Syrup as advised by the doctor. Dilute in water before consuming. Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects while taking Proliser syrup.

How FORTIBILE 150MG TABLET Works

name: HEPATREAT Sachet 5gm
introduction:
Introduction About HEPATREAT SACHET

HEPATREAT SACHET contains L-ornithine-L-aspartate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Hepatoprotective agents. It is used in the management of concomitant diseases and complications caused by deterioration of liver detoxification function, with symptoms of latent or severe hepatic encephalopathy and consciousness disorders such as precoma or coma.

L-ornithine-l-aspartate is made up of two amino acids called ornithine and aspartic acid. Both l-ornithine and l-aspartic acid ensure hepatoprotective effects by decreasing the toxic load on the liver and by providing metabolic support for hepatic cells. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have severe liver disease, because your doctor might adjust the dose on an individual basis to avoid nausea and vomiting.

This medicine is well tolerated with minimal side effects. However, if you experience any unusual symptoms after taking this medicine, inform your doctor. Do not take this medicine if you have severe renal impairment, diabetes, or fructose intolerance. Ask your doctor for advice. If a high dose of this medicine is used, it is important to monitor the levels of urea both in the serum and urine to avoid toxicity. Ask your doctor for advice before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
uses: Restores normal liver function
Manages concomitant diseases caused by deterioration of liver function
Manages symptoms of latent or severe hepatic encephalopathy
Manages consciousness disorders such as precoma or coma
usesDetails:
Uses Of HEPATREAT SACHET
Restores normal liver function
Manages concomitant diseases caused by deterioration of liver function
Manages symptoms of latent or severe hepatic encephalopathy
Manages consciousness disorders such as precoma or coma
mechanismOfAction:
How HEPATREAT SACHET Works

L-ornithine converts toxic ammonia into non-toxic urea, which is eliminated via the kidneys. By doing this, it lowers the elevated level of toxic load (ammonia) in blood and helps the diseased liver to carry out its normal function smoothly (detoxification). L-aspartate is an important component of the citric acid cycle, which liberates energy in the form of ATP, which helps in the regeneration of damaged liver cells.
usageDetails:
How to use HEPATREAT SACHET

Always take this medicine as directed by your physician. Dissolve the contents of 1-2 sachets in a large amount of fluid (Ex. in a glass of water or juice) and consume orally, 3 times a day during or after meals. introduction:
Introduction About ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET

ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET Works

ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.
usageInstructions: Always use ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Take this medicine with or after meals.
For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water or milk. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.
Continue to take ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
If you feel that the effect of ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET is too strong or too weak for you, please talk to your doctor.

warnings.details: ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary by the doctor.
ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it passes through breast milk.
ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET has no or negligible effect on driving or using machine.
ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Your doctor might advise you for frequent liver examination and tests during the management.
Do not take ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET if you are allergic to allergic to Ursodeoxycholic Acid or bile acids or any other components of this medicine.

ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET should be used in children only if prescribed by the physician. It should not be used in children with biliary atresia (blockage in bile duct) or in children having poor bile flow, even after surgery.
ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET can be used in elderly patients under medical supervision.

Others

ESTUCHOL 150 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have improper functioning of gall bladder
Have calcified gallstones which are visible on an x-ray
Have an acute inflammation of the biliary tract or gall bladder
Have a blockage of the cystic duct or common bile duct (obstruction of the biliary tract)
Experience frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen

introduction:
Introduction About MAXILIV INJECTION

MAXILIV INJECTION contains Glutathione which belongs to the group of medicines called Antioxidants. It is used to manage alcoholic fatty liver (disease that occurs due to heavy alcohol use), liver fibrosis/cirrhosis (scarring of liver due to excessive consumption of alcohol), and hepatitis (inflammation of liver) in affected individuals.

MAXILIV INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Glutathione. Before receiving MAXILIV INJECTION, inform your doctor if you suffer from liver problems (such as chronic hepatitis), and kidney problems (such as acute renal failure).

MAXILIV INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in neonates, premature infants, children, and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving MAXILIV INJECTION are anorexia (eating disorder), nausea, vomiting, and/or rash. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Liver fibrosis/cirrhosis (scarring of liver tissue due to excessive consumption of alcohol)
Hepatitis (inflammation of liver) in affected individuals

name: Hepcinat 400mg Tablet 28'S
introduction:
Introduction About HEPCINAT 400MG TABLET

HEPCINAT 400MG TABLET contains Sofosbuvir which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiviral agents. HEPCINAT 400MG TABLET is used with Ribavirin/ Peginterferon alfa and ribavirin (antiviral medicines) to manage hepatitis C viral infection in adults and children (aged 3 years/above), which is a type of viral infection that infects the liver.

HEPCINAT 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Sofosbuvir.

Before taking HEPCINAT 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a  history of hepatitis B virus infection, and/or suffer from diabetes, heart problems, kidney problems, and/or other liver problems.

HEPCINAT 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy since Ribavirin (antiviral medicine used with Sofosbuvir) may cause harm to the unborn baby. Women of childbearing potential should use effective contraceptive measures to avoid getting pregnant and undergo a routine pregnancy test during and after management (for 9 months).  If accidental pregnancy occurs, then it should be informed to the doctor immediately. The medicine is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women since it is not known whether the medicine may pass through breast milk.

HEPCINAT 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (aged below 3 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of taking HEPCINAT 400MG TABLET are fever, chills, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, feeling depressed/anxious/agitated, and/or headache. Consult with your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage Hepatitis C viral infection in adults and children (aged 3 years/above) when used with Ribavirin/ Peginterferon alfa and ribavirin (antiviral medicines)
usesDetails:
Uses Of HEPCINAT 400MG TABLET
Manage Hepatitis C viral infection in adults and children (aged 3 years/above) when used with Ribavirin/ Peginterferon alfa and ribavirin (antiviral medicines)
mechanismOfAction:
How HEPCINAT 400MG TABLET Works

Sofosbuvir works by lowering the load of hepatitis C virus in the body by binding to hepatitis C virus RNA and interfering with its life cycle thus managing the viral replication in the body and managing the infection in affected individuals.

name: URSOLID 300 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About URSOLID 300 TABLET

URSOLID 300 TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, URSOLID 300 TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

URSOLID 300 TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

URSOLID 300 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. URSOLID 300 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

URSOLID 300 TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. URSOLID 300 TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with URSOLID 300 TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking URSOLID 300 TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)
Gallstones (not visible on X-rays in patients with a functioning gall bladder)
Liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to 18 years

mechanismOfAction:
How URSOLID 300 TABLET Works

URSOLID 300 TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.
usageInstructions: Always use URSOLID 300 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Take this medicine with or after meals.
For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water or milk. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of URSOLID 300 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.
Continue to take URSOLID 300 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
If you feel that the effect of URSOLID 300 TABLET is too strong or too weak for you, please talk to your doctor.

name: Sorliv Liquid 200ml
introduction:
Introduction About SORLIVE

Sorliv Solution is a hepatoprotective medicine used to improve appetite and liver function, manages hepatotoxicity, normalizes intestinal peristalsis movement and provides relief from constipation. It contains tricholine citrate and sorbitol as active ingredients to improve liver functioning.    

Tricholine citrate binds to bile in gastrointestinal tract and removes bile acids from the body. The liver in turn produces more bile acid using cholesterol as a substrate. Sorbitol acts as a laxative to provide relief from constipation.

Always take Sorliv Solution as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. Recommended dosage for adults is 10 ml (2 teaspoonful) twice daily before meals, for children 5 ml (1 teaspoonful) twice daily before meals and for infants 2.5 ml (1/2 teaspoonful) twice daily before meals or as directed by the doctor. Do not take this medicine if you are allergic to any of its components.

name: Adenomac 400mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ADENOMAC 400MG TABLET

ADENOMAC 400MG TABLET contains S-Adenosyl-L-Methionine which belongs to the group of medicines called Amino acid derivatives. It is used to manage liver problems such as intrahepatic cholestasis (ICP; block in bile flow), liver cirrhosis, hepatitis and alcoholic liver disease in adults.

It can also be used to manage ICP of pregnancy and can reduce the fatigue caused by chronic liver problems. It also helps to reduce joint pain (osteoarthritis), fibromyalgia (severe muscle pain with memory and mood problems), anxiety, depression and other mental illnesses.

Before taking ADENOMAC 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have bipolar disorder or a previous history of suicidal thoughts as a precaution.

Vitamins such as folic acid and vitamin B12 are essential to enhance the effects of S-Adenosyl-L-Methionine in your body. Therefore, inform your doctor if you have any vitamin deficiencies or anemia as a precaution. You doctor may advise you to take B-vitamin supplements (folic acid and vitamin B12) along with this medicine.

During management with ADENOMAC 400MG TABLET your doctor will routinely monitor the levels of ammonia, folic acid and vitamin B12 in your blood as a precaution and adjust the dose accordingly.

Do not take ADENOMAC 400MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ADENOMAC 400MG TABLET are nausea, stomach pain and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How ADENOMAC 400MG TABLET Works

ADENOMAC 400MG TABLET protects your liver against various toxins (free radicals) and helps your liver to function normally. It improves the levels of glutathione (an antioxidant) in the liver which helps in managing further liver cell damage.

It also increases the levels of certain chemical messengers (such as dopamine, noradrenaline, adrenaline, serotonin, melatonin) in the brain that can stabilize mood and mental health. It can also reduce the production of certain chemicals in the body that causes pain and inflammation.

name: UDCANORM 300 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About UDCANORM 300 TABLET

UDCANORM 300 TABLET is used in the management of gall stones and primary biliary cirrhosis (damage of bile ducts in the liver leading to the buildup of bile). It can also be used for liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to less than 18 years.

It contains Ursodeoxycholic Acid, which is a liver health supplement that works by removing toxins from the liver, thereby improving its function. For gall stone dissolution, UDCANORM 300 TABLET works by reducing cholesterol produced by the gall bladder

UDCANORM 300 TABLET should be used only under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals.

UDCANORM 300 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with allergies to bile acids, calcified gallstones, inflammation of the gallbladder or the bile ducts, blockage of the common bile duct or cystic duct, frequent cramp-like pains in the upper abdomen, low bile flow in children, or improper function of the gall bladder. UDCANORM 300 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases.

UDCANORM 300 TABLET should be taken during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. UDCANORM 300 TABLET can be used in children, adolescents, and the elderly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy with UDCANORM 300 TABLET for you.

The most common side effects of taking UDCANORM 300 TABLET are soft, loose stools or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen or don’t improve.
uses: Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC)
Gallstones (not visible on X-rays in patients with a functioning gall bladder)
Liver disease associated with cystic fibrosis in children aged 6 to 18 years

mechanismOfAction:
How UDCANORM 300 TABLET Works

UDCANORM 300 TABLET supports liver detoxification by increasing the bile flow through the liver and protects liver cells. It is concentrated in bile and decreases biliary cholesterol by suppressing the formation of new cholesterol by inhibiting its intestinal absorption. The reduced cholesterol levels lead to gradually solubilization of cholesterol from gallstones, resulting in their dissolution.
usageInstructions: Always use UDCANORM 300 TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Take this medicine with or after meals.
For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water or milk. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of UDCANORM 300 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of disease condition.
Continue to take UDCANORM 300 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
If you feel that the effect of UDCANORM 300 TABLET is too strong or too weak for you, please talk to your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About ADENOMAC 200MG TABLET

Adenomac 200mg Tablet is a dietary supplement used to manage depression, osteoarthritis, cirrhosis, intrahepatic cholestasis, alcohol induced liver disorders. It contains S-Adenosyl L-methionine as an active ingredient that help to improve liver, joint, and brain health.

S-Adenosyl L-methionine  is an amino acid that help to regulate metabolism and detoxification process in the body as well as it helps to maintain the action of hormones and neurotransmitters that affect the mood.

Always take Adenomac 200mg Tablet exactly as advised by your doctor. Swallow Adenomac 200mg Tablet with a glass of water. Do not exceed the stated daily recommended dosages.

introduction:
Introduction About HEPAVION SOFTGEL

HEPAVION SOFTGEL is a combination of Metadoxine, Silymarin and L Ornithine L Aspartate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antioxidants, Flavonolignans and Amino acid salts respectively. It is used as supportive management in chronic liver disease and cirrhosis.  

Chronic liver disease (CLD) is a continuous process of inflammation, destruction and regeneration of functional liver cells, which leads to cirrhosis (disruption of liver structure and function). Symptoms include fluid build-up in the belly, itching, yellow skin and eyes, muscle loss, loss of appetite, easy bruising, low energy and weakness, weight loss and confusion.

Consult your doctor before giving HEPAVION SOFTGEL to your child. Before taking HEPAVION SOFTGEL, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing conditions or allergies. HEPAVION SOFTGEL is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary by your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking HEPAVION SOFTGEL are gastrointestinal disturbances (such as indigestion, diarrhoea), nausea and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: As supportive management in chronic liver disease and cirrhosis

As supportive management in chronic liver disease and cirrhosis
mechanismOfAction:
How HEPAVION SOFTGEL Works

HEPAVION SOFTGEL improves liver function where metadoxine exerts a protective effect against the damage done by free radicals, silymarin acts as a rejuvenating agent which helps in regenerating the damaged liver cells and in liver decongestion and L-Ornithine L-Aspartate converts ammonia to urea, leading to reduced burden of the liver and thus increases functional capacity of the liver.
